name: Accordion
description: A framework-free Web Component that animates the native disclosure element, keeps one panel open at a time without a script, and gives every panel a heading and a region.

variants.name: Default
variants.description: A group of panels that open and close independently, with one open to begin with.

variants.name: Exclusive
variants.description: One panel open at a time, enforced by the browser before the script arrives and by the component after it.

variants.name: Icons
variants.description: The marker at the start or the end, a supplied icon, and a summary carrying secondary text.

variants.name: Actions
variants.description: Panels holding real content and a row of buttons along the foot.

variants.name: States
variants.description: A disabled panel that still takes focus, one open by default, and a panel long enough to scroll.

variants.name: Controlled
variants.description: Opening and closing from outside the component, with every change reported back.
